Method of Attack: Exploiting a critical Netscaler vulnerability (CVE-2023-4966) to circumvent login requirements and multifactor authentication protections
Stealing session tokens from unpatched Citrix appliances
Used by ransomware gangs to breach networks and deploy ransomware
Discoverer: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) Health Sector Cybersecurity Coordination Center (HC3)
Impacted Systems: Thousands of Citrix servers worldwide including critical organizations
Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of unpatched Citrix NetScaler appliances
Session hijacking by stealing authentication tokens
Ransomware attacks by LockBit gang exploiting the vulnerability
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept exploit released by AssetNote on October 25, 2023
Active exploitation as a zero-day since at least late August 2023
Reports of breached networks including Boeing in October 2023
